SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PA_SUMMARY_$CPNY_ID$ PA_SUMMARY, PA_LOW_ADJUST PA_LOW_ADJUST WHERE PA_SUMMARY.PA_MONTH = PA_LOW_ADJUST.PA_MONTH(+) AND PA_SUMMARY.PERSON_ID = PA_LOW_ADJUST.PERSON_ID(+) AND (CASE WHEN F_GET_UNPROMO_LOWS_DIS(PA_SUMMARY.PA_MONTH,PA_SUMMARY.CPNY_ID,PA_SUMMARY.INSRAREA_ID) = 'SQ' THEN PA_SUMMARY.Gross_Pay ELSE PA_SUMMARY.Net_Pay END ) < F_GET_UNPROMO_LOWS_SALARY(PA_SUMMARY.PA_MONTH,PA_SUMMARY.CPNY_ID,PA_SUMMARY.INSRAREA_ID) AND PA_SUMMARY.EMP_TYPE_CODE NOT IN ('211316','211804','211814','210651','210711', '210864','210865') AND F_GET_UNPROMO_LOWS_DIS(PA_SUMMARY.PA_MONTH,PA_SUMMARY.CPNY_ID,PA_SUMMARY.INSRAREA_ID) IS NOT NULL
PA_SUMMARY.PA_MONTH = #PA_MONTH:VARCHAR#
PA_SUMMARY.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
PA_LOW_ADJUST.CPNY_ID(+) = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
( PA_SUMMARY.EMPID LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR PA_SUMMARY.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' )
PA_LOW_ADJUST.ACTIVITY = #ACTIVITY:VARCHAR#
EXISTS(SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = PA_SUMMARY.DEPTNO START WITH HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = #DEPT_NO:VARCHAR# CONNECT BY PRIOR HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT.PARENT_DEPT_NO)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PA_SUMMARY_$CPNY_ID$ PA_SUMMARY, PA_LOW_ADJUST PA_LOW_ADJUST, HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE PA_SUMMARY.PA_MONTH = PA_LOW_ADJUST.PA_MONTH(+) AND PA_SUMMARY.PERSON_ID = PA_LOW_ADJUST.PERSON_ID(+) AND HR.PERSON_ID = PA_SUMMARY.PERSON_ID AND hr.emp_office='15119' AND (CASE WHEN F_GET_UNPROMO_LOWS_DIS(PA_SUMMARY.PA_MONTH,PA_SUMMARY.CPNY_ID,PA_SUMMARY.INSRAREA_ID) = 'SQ' THEN PA_SUMMARY.Gross_Pay ELSE PA_SUMMARY.Net_Pay END ) < F_GET_UNPROMO_LOWS_SALARY(PA_SUMMARY.PA_MONTH,PA_SUMMARY.CPNY_ID,PA_SUMMARY.INSRAREA_ID) AND PA_SUMMARY.EMP_TYPE_CODE NOT IN ('211316','211804','211814','210651','210711', '210864','210865') AND F_GET_UNPROMO_LOWS_DIS(PA_SUMMARY.PA_MONTH,PA_SUMMARY.CPNY_ID,PA_SUMMARY.INSRAREA_ID) IS NOT NULL
PA_SUMMARY.PA_MONTH = #PA_MONTH:VARCHAR#
PA_SUMMARY.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
PA_LOW_ADJUST.CPNY_ID(+) = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
( PA_SUMMARY.EMPID LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR PA_SUMMARY.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' )
PA_LOW_ADJUST.ACTIVITY = #ACTIVITY:VARCHAR#
EXISTS(SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = PA_SUMMARY.DEPTNO START WITH HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = #DEPT_NO:VARCHAR# CONNECT BY PRIOR HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
